# Copilot Instructions

Follow Ponytail principles.

- Make the smallest possible complete change.
- Prefer existing code to new code.
- Prefer deletion to addition.
- Never add dependencies unless explicitly requested.
- Never refactor unrelated code.
- Modify the minimum number of files required.
- Read only files directly relevant to the task.
- For new logic, add a test.
- Show the implementation plan before making changes.
